title: Reset demo from a non-dashboard page still strands on a perpetual spinner — r1 W13 fold 'reset navigates home' did not land
evidence:
fn reset_demo(model: Model) -> #(Model, Effect(Msg)) {
  case demo_store.seed() {
    Ok(store) -> {
      demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_reset)
      let #(vacancies, stats) = demo_store.dashboard(store)
      let landlord = demo_store.landlord(store)
      #(
        Model(
          ..model,
          demo_store: Some(store),
          auth: Success(landlord),
          vacancies: Success(vacancies),
          dashboard_stats: Success(stats),
          vacancy_detail: NotAsked,
          leaderboard: NotAsked,
          application_detail: NotAsked,
          comparison_details: NotAsked,
          archived_vacancies: NotAsked,
          awaiting_list: NotAsked,
          notifications: NotAsked,
          toasts: [],
        ),
        demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications),
      )
    ... — route is never changed (no modem.push). application_detail.gleam:40 "NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()".
detail: The banner reset button is global chrome; resetting while on a detail/archived/comparison page wipes that page's data to NotAsked with no refetch and no navigation — infinite spinner. Carry-forward since round 1.
recommended_fix: In reset_demo, also modem.push("/demo", None, None) (or refetch the current route's data from the fresh store).

title: Vacuous r1-W14 fix: 4 of 9 demo analytics events are wired to messages no production code dispatches — 'key surfaces' never captured
evidence: demo_update.gleam:218 "demo_analytics.capture_event(demo_analytics.demo_vacancy_open)" (inside AppRequestedVacancyDetail), :281 demo_application_open (inside AppRequestedApplicationDetail), :340 demo_archived_open (inside AppRequestedArchivedVacancies), :426 demo_comparison_open (inside AppRequestedComparisonDetails). Dispatch-site grep: AppRequestedApplicationDetail and AppRequestedComparisonDetails appear ONLY in client.gleam handlers (2469, 3602) and demo_flow_test.gleam:127 — zero production dispatch sites. AppRequestedVacancyDetail is dispatched only from vacancy_detail.gleam:89 ("event.on_click(msg.AppRequestedVacancyDetail(vacancy_id))" on the Failure retry btn, data-testid="vacancy-detail-retry-btn") and AppRequestedArchivedVacancies only from archived_vacancies.gleam:159 (retry btn). Actual demo navigation goes BrowserChangedUrl -> handle_browser_change (client.gleam:5216 "// demo: resolve detail + leaderboard from the store.") which fires no analytics; the only capture_event in client.gleam is enter_demo's demo_entry (:5779).
detail: Deliverable 7 requires 'capturing entry, key surfaces, downloads, CTA clicks'. The rework wired capture calls on dead paths — the demo store always resolves Ok, so retry buttons never render; surface events can never fire.
recommended_fix: Fire demo_vacancy_open/demo_application_open/demo_comparison_open/demo_archived_open from handle_browser_change's demo branches (or enter_demo navigation), not from retry-only request messages.

title: Real-person fixture swap landed only in the PDF — client fixture still renders 'Grace Kelly' on eviction/CCJ data, now mismatching its own report
evidence: demo_fixtures.gleam:93 const app_grace_json = "{\"id\":\"a-grace\",...\"first_name\":\"Grace\",\"last_name\":\"Kelly\",\"email\":\"grainne.foley@example.ie\",...\"has_eviction_history\":true,\"eviction_details\":\"Rent arrears, possession order settled in 2024\",\"has_ccjs\":true,...\"status\":\"rejected\"...}" vs server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:207-213: fn row_grace() -> GetApplicationDetailRow { let base = base_row("a-grace", "Gráinne", "Foley", "grainne.foley@example.ie", ...) and :424 applicant_name: "Gráinne Foley".

The UI (leaderboard, applicant detail, comparison) still shows the famous real person's name on adverse rental data — r1 W19 still present — and downloading that applicant's report now yields a differently-named PDF.

title: r1 blocker B2's store-threading fix has no biting pin — a reintroduced 'let _ = next' passes make test and the lint
evidence: demo_flow_test.gleam contains exactly seven tests: demo_entry_shows_dashboard_test, demo_dashboard_resolves_test, demo_vacancy_detail_and_leaderboard_resolve_test, demo_application_detail_resolves_test, demo_reset_wipes_state_test, demo_exit_clears_demo_state_test, demo_requests_are_intercepted_test — none drives create_vacancy/update_vacancy/mark_application_opened through client.update (grep for create_vacancy|update_vacancy|mark_application_opened across client/test/ returns nothing). The four fixed sites (client.gleam:1850, 2570, 6048, 6255/6375 "demo_store: Some(next)") are read-only code; lint_demo_network.py only checks api-call guarding, not store threading.
detail: r2 briefing bar: 'every r1 blocker is verified-fixed with a biting test/lint'. B2 (mutations discarding the store) is fixed in code but unpinned — silent regression would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add a demo_flow test: drive demo create + edit-save + mark-opened through client.update, assert the new/edited vacancy is visible in the model's demo_store afterwards.

title: Demo boot skips installing the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the whole page lifetime — a login after demo exit loses the multi-tab policy-sync defence
detail: A landlord who enters the demo, exits to /login, and signs in (same tab, no reload) runs a real session without the production multi-tab policy-sync listener or sweep-nudge/refcheck hydration until a hard reload.
recommended_fix: Install listen_visibility_refresh (and the hydrations) when demo mode exits to a public route, or on first real auth success.
